left_findings.quote: The child has grown in confidence and expressive ability throughout the semester.
left_findings.source_fact: During small-group picture discussions, answers questions using one or two words when the teacher asks a direct question. During a picture discussion with two classmates, uses short sentences to describe what the characters are doing, with teacher questions to help extend the description. At a class sharing session about a visit to the park, confidently tells classmates about seeing ducks and playing on the slide. Uses a drawing to support the account and needs a reminder to begin. In the two most recent class sharing sessions, uses a drawing and a reminder to begin to tell classmates about a personal experience in three or four sentences. Answers one follow-up question from a peer with a teacher prompt.
left_findings.explanation: Confidence is explicitly observed only in May; its growth throughout the semester is not established.
